suggested_issue_title: README links to docs/one_command_web_optimizer.md, which does not exist in the repository
suggested_issue_body:
repository-presenter's validation pipeline (BC-06) recorded this while re-verifying `aspose-font-foss/Aspose.Font-FOSS-for-Python`; it was then reproduced independently against the live default-branch head `adf4885a3a5d4ddb7e30e737e83e72a44ee8dec6` on 2026-10-09T21:36Z.

## Summary

The CLI Usage section links `[One-Command Web Font Optimizer Guide](docs/one_command_web_optimizer.md)` (README.md line 518). The root of the repository contains `.gitignore CHANGELOG.md CODEOWNERS LICENSE.txt Makefile README.md SECURITY.md pyproject.toml setup.py src testdata tests uv.lock`; there is no `docs/` directory.

## Environment

- Revision `adf4885a3a5d4ddb7e30e737e83e72a44ee8dec6` (default branch `main`)

## Steps to reproduce

```sh
gh api repos/aspose-font-foss/Aspose.Font-FOSS-for-Python/contents/docs
gh api 'repos/aspose-font-foss/Aspose.Font-FOSS-for-Python/git/trees/adf4885a3a5d4ddb7e30e737e83e72a44ee8dec6?recursive=1' --jq '.tree[].path' | grep -i optimizer
```

## Actual result

The first call returns HTTP 404. The recursive tree lists `src/aspose_font/optimizer.py` and `tests/test_web_optimizer_*.py`, and no `docs/one_command_web_optimizer.md`.

## Where in the repository

- `README.md:518`

## Evidence

- `README.md`: line 518: [One-Command Web Font Optimizer Guide](docs/one_command_web_optimizer.md) (revision adf4885a3a5d4ddb7e30e737e83e72a44ee8dec6)
- `gh api repos/aspose-font-foss/Aspose.Font-FOSS-for-Python/contents/docs`: 2026-10-09T21:36Z: HTTP 404 Not Found
- `gh api repos/aspose-font-foss/Aspose.Font-FOSS-for-Python/git/trees/adf4885a3a5d4ddb7e30e737e83e72a44ee8dec6?recursive=1`: no path matching docs/ or one_command_web_optimizer.md
